# Cash Management

This folder is derived from [billing-accounts-finance.md](../../../billing-accounts-finance.md) and represents a menu or nested menu item. Each non-README Markdown file represents one permanent table workspace tab.

## Tabs

| Tab | Section slug | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [Cash Counts](cash-counts.md) | `cash-counts` | Manages the end-to-end cash counts workflow for Cash Management. |
| [Cash Points](cash-points.md) | `cash-points` | Maintains the authoritative cash points records used by Cash Management. |
| [Cash Reconciliation](cash-reconciliation.md) | `cash-reconciliation` | Coordinates cash reconciliation as an exception-driven worklist. |
| [Cash Transactions](cash-transactions.md) | `cash-transactions` | Provides a read-oriented cash transactions table for analysis, reconciliation, drill-down, printing, and export without duplicating the authoritative source transactions. |
| [Cash Transfers](cash-transfers.md) | `cash-transfers` | Manages the end-to-end cash transfers workflow for Cash Management. |
| [Cash Variances](cash-variances.md) | `cash-variances` | Manages the end-to-end cash variances workflow for Cash Management. |
| [Cashier Sessions](cashier-sessions.md) | `cashier-sessions` | Manages the end-to-end cashier sessions workflow for Cash Management. |
| [Session Closures](session-closures.md) | `session-closures` | Manages the end-to-end session closures workflow for Cash Management. |

## Implementation contract

- Run the [reuse audit](../../_shared/existing-implementation.md) first; most of this scope already exists.
- Every listed workspace tab is an `AppListTable` worklist or tabular report.
- Forms and workflow actions open from toolbar/row buttons in dialogs.
- Permissions, entitlement, ABAC, human-friendly IDs, export/print, audit, and targeted refresh are mandatory.
- Use the [shared finance contracts](../../_shared/README.md) for tables, dialogs, permissions, API behavior, state, and audit.
